name: @wing-agent/desktop
description: Wing desktop shell — Electron main process around the shared web client.
author: wing-agent
//: Private Electron shell (apps/desktop). Ships NO runtime dependencies: the main process only uses electron built-ins and node builtins, and the renderer is the apps/web build dropped into renderer/. devDependencies are the toolchain (esbuild bundles src/ into dist/, electron-builder turns dist/ + renderer/ into the .app). See docs/dev/web-desktop.md and 05_electron_scaffold/design.md.
//exports: The shell's main process is loaded by path (electron-builder `main`), so `exports` only serves workspace consumers: apps/web reuses the frozen preload contract from `src/bridge.ts` (step 10 of the wing-app plan).
